title: [UX/UI] Provider Communication — Document Attachment / Send Communication via Email

walkthroughSteps.title: Send communication
walkthroughSteps.body: Every provider assignment has a Send communication action for reaching out with instructions or requests.
walkthroughSteps.expectedAfterClick: Opens the send-communication flow — this is where the instruction template and document attachment (BMPCC-14453) and email send (BMPCC-14454) designs apply.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Every provider assignment has a Send communication action
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: Every row in Provider Management has a **Send communication** action, independent of assignment status.

setup.description: Uses CLM-2024-001's existing provider assignments — no override needed

preconditions.text: Send communication button visible on every provider row

expectedUI.description: Send communication opens the outreach flow
visualCues: Send communication button on every row

howToTest.trigger: Click Send communication on any provider row
